headline: The 9 abdominal regions
body:
Upper middle: epigastric
Center: umbilical
Lower middle: hypogastric
Upper sides: R + L hypochondriac
Middle sides: R + L lumbar
Lower sides: R + L iliac
source: Source: Hartline, Human Anatomy Lab Manual 1.6 (LibreTexts)

headline: Endocrine glands and what they do
body:
Hypothalamus: controls the pituitary
Pituitary: runs other glands
Thyroid: metabolism
Parathyroids: calcium balance
Adrenals: adrenaline, corticosteroids
Pancreas: insulin + glucagon
Ovaries + testes: sex hormones
source: Source: Cedars-Sinai, Anatomy of the Endocrine System
